summary: Published runx skill iwannabefree00/contract-drafter@sha-8f6b4fdaeab7 drafts a contract only from supplied template, parties, and terms; hosted registry harness passed two cases, clean install resolved from the public registry, and the revision repair submits the actual runx-cli runtime receipt persisted by a post-publish dogfood run of the published registry ref.

publish.method: runx login --provider github --for publish; direct hosted registry API equivalent to runx registry publish ./skills/contract-drafter/SKILL.md --registry https://api.runx.ai

hosted_harness.note: Harness fixture receipts are intentionally not reused as delivery receipt_ref; delivery receipt_ref is dogfood.receipt_ref below.

dogfood.command: runx skill iwannabefree00/contract-drafter@sha-8f6b4fdaeab7 --registry https://api.runx.ai --input-json template=<json> --input-json parties=<json> --input-json terms=<json> --receipt-dir .runx/receipts-registry-ref-ci-20260714 --json

hosted_run_note.reason: Hosted runs API access for this local token lacks runs:read/runs:write scope, so the repair uses official runx-cli 0.6.16 against the remote registry ref and submits the persisted runtime receipt file.

lineage.message: single receipt verification cannot prove receipt-tree lineage

dogfood.verify_command: RUNX_RECEIPT_VERIFY_KID=<see public key json> RUNX_RECEIPT_VERIFY_ED25519_PUBLIC_KEY_BASE64=<see public key json> runx verify --receipt contract-drafter-dogfood-receipt.json --json
dogfood.windows_receipt_store_note: Revision repair: this delivery now submits the actual receipt file persisted by `runx skill` for the published registry ref. The Windows runx process wrote the receipt and `runx verify` validates it, then reported a receipt-store directory sync/readability error (`os error 5`) while finalizing the receipt store. The raw stdout is included; the submitted receipt_ref is the runtime receipt, not a hand-minted package-subject observation receipt.
dogfood.review_fix_note: Revision fix: replaced the rejected package-subject CI observation receipt with the actual runx-cli runtime receipt persisted by `runx skill` for the published registry ref; verify verdict is valid=true.

observations: runx --version for the final dogfood/verify path returned runx-cli 0.6.16, satisfying the required minimum.
The verified publisher owner from registry read is iwannabefree00 for iwannabefree00/contract-drafter.
The package name is exactly contract-drafter and the published registry ref is iwannabefree00/contract-drafter@sha-8f6b4fdaeab7.
Hosted registry harness passed with two cases: sealed-draft-with-visible-deviations and refused-missing-required-payment-term.
The sealed harness case produced draft_doc, three visible deviations, and a gated send_proposal with no send performed.
The refused case omits the required payment_terms input and emits no draft_doc and no send_proposal.
Post-publish dogfood stdout status=sealed from run_id run_draft_5dc75c805aac resolved trusted registry provenance version sha-8f6b4fdaeab7.
Post-publish dogfood output produced draft_ref draft:22427e568e49c844 and deviations for governing_law, liability_cap, and payment_terms.
The send_proposal is explicitly status gated_not_sent and names downstream_skill send-as; this skill never sends.
Clean install succeeded with runx add iwannabefree00/contract-drafter@sha-8f6b4fdaeab7 --registry https://api.runx.ai.
The implementation never invents parties or terms: it validates provider/customer legal names and refuses missing required terms.
Every deviation names clause, baseline, and proposed_change.
The public verification key is recorded in contract-drafter-dogfood-public-key.json; it is not secret material.

Revision repair submits runtime receipt sha256:7dbd1986789598b8bb49fdd83c3fff2d9dfebc3bc91243aebbf3dc061013e256 as artifact_refs.receipt_ref; it was persisted by runx-cli 0.6.16 while executing iwannabefree00/contract-drafter@sha-8f6b4fdaeab7 from remote registry provenance.

The submitted receipt subject is harness (hrn_run_draft_5dc75c805aac_draft); this is intentionally the runx runtime receipt requested by review, not the previously rejected package-subject CI observation receipt.

`runx verify --receipt contract-drafter-dogfood-receipt.json --json` returned valid=true with digest.status=valid, content_address.status=valid, and signature.status=valid using kid agent-497c05-contract-drafter-dogfood.

The raw dogfood stdout records a Windows receipt-store finalization error after the receipt was written; the persisted receipt file and verify verdict are included so the review can validate the runtime receipt independently.
